description: The one shared Renovate preset for every repo Dreamwright works in, on activescott and ping-poet. A repo extends it with "github>ping-poet/.github" and keeps its own packageRules in its renovate.json. Policy: Scott's 2026-11-07 decisions on ping-poet/dreamwright#748.
This repo is public on purpose: Mend's hosted app can't read a private preset from another account, so the old preset in ping-poet/dreamwright (private) never reached the activescott repos.
Based on activescott/tinkerbell's renovate.json, which has run since tinkerbell#184.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security updates open right away and skip the weekly schedule (Renovate's default). Renovate also sets minimumReleaseAge to null for them by default, so it is set again here: without it, a poisoned 'security' release would skip the 24 hours.

packageRules.description: Every non-major update in the repo goes into one PR, opened on Mondays (Pacific) and auto-merged when CI is green. The window is all of Monday, not tinkerbell's old 'before 6am', because Renovate doesn't always run inside a narrow window. Renovate needs at least one passing check to automerge, so a repo without CI never automerges. The type is pinned to chore so a group that mixes dependencies and devDependencies gets one commit type.
Each major opens as its own PR once it passes minimumReleaseAge. Not grouped, not auto-merged, and never held for Dependency Dashboard approval (Scott, 11-07: 'we'd just never see them').

Security fixes go first when prConcurrentLimit is reached. prPriority isn't allowed under vulnerabilityAlerts, so it is set here; matchJsonata on vulnerabilityFixVersion is how tinkerbell matches a vulnerability fix.

Packages that are used together get one PR for a major. activescott/auth#156 bumped only @simple-release/core to 3.x and left npm and github on 2.x, though scripts/release.ts uses all three. Minor and patch updates already come together in the weekly group. Families every repo shares go here; a repo's own families go in its renovate.json.
